Module dev.metaschema.core

Package dev.metaschema.core.datatype

package dev.metaschema.core.datatype
The Metaschema and Metapath data type system API.

This package provides the core framework for the Metaschema type system, enabling type definitions, conversions, and serialization across XML, JSON, and YAML formats. The type system supports both built-in Metaschema types and custom type extensions.

Key Interfaces

  • IDataTypeAdapter - Defines conversion operations between Java types and Metaschema data representations, including parsing, serialization, and validation.
  • IDataTypeProvider - Service provider interface for registering data type adapters and abstract types, supporting pluggable type extensions.
  • ICustomJavaDataType - Marker interface for custom Java types that require specialized handling beyond simple primitives.

Key Classes

  • DataTypeService - Central registry for data type discovery using Java SPI, managing all available type adapters.
  • AbstractDataTypeAdapter - Base implementation providing common adapter functionality for concrete type implementations.
  • AbstractDataTypeProvider - Base implementation for type providers with support for registering multiple adapters.

Usage Context

The data type system is used throughout the Metaschema framework for:

  • Parsing and validating field values in Metaschema documents
  • Converting between Java objects and XML/JSON/YAML representations
  • Supporting Metapath expressions with typed atomic values
  • Enabling custom type extensions through the SPI mechanism

Concrete type implementations are provided in the adapter subpackage, while specialized types for markup and temporal values are in their respective subpackages.
